loading a path to a sandbox folder

So the idea is that the agent can only read
and write files in that sandbox folder,
nowhere else.
And in order to ensure this,
ReadFile and WriteFile, these tools
always construct paths that are in that
sandbox folder. So whenever the agent makes
a read or write file request, we
automatically move that request, so to say,
into that sandbox folder. There is no way of
working outside of it with these tools.
If the agent had a bash tool, it could
circumvent these tools, so it could write
its own programs then, but it doesn't have

always end up in those sandbox folders or in

construct paths that use that sandbox

nonetheless working approach of restricting
